title: Fridge — Overview
description: Temperature for the three zones. Readings are stored under each sensor's ROM code and the zone name is joined on by the `temperature` view, so naming a sensor relabels its whole history. If the three tiles are empty, the sensors have not been named yet — see the table at the bottom.

targets.queryText:
SELECT ts, celsius
FROM temperature
WHERE zone = 'freezer'
  AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
ORDER BY ts

FROM temperature
WHERE zone = 'freezer'

panels.title: Temperature — all three zones
panels.description: Bucketed to 60 s with $__unixEpochGroupSeconds, the only grouping macro this plugin provides. Readings arrive every 30 s, so a bucket averages a pair. Nulls are NOT spanned: the 30 s gap after the board reboots is real and should look like a gap.

targets.queryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds("ts", 60) AS ts,
       AVG(CASE WHEN zone = 'freezer'       THEN celsius END) AS "Freezer",
       AVG(CASE WHEN zone = 'fridge_top'    THEN celsius END) AS "Top shelf",
       AVG(CASE WHEN zone = 'fridge_bottom' THEN celsius END) AS "Bottom shelf"
FROM temperature
WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds("ts", 60) AS ts,
       AVG(CASE WHEN zone = 'freezer'       THEN celsius END) AS "Freezer",
       AVG(CASE WHEN zone = 'fridge_top'    THEN celsius END) AS "Top shelf",
       AVG(CASE WHEN zone = 'fridge_bottom' THEN celsius END) AS "Bottom shelf"
FROM temperature
WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: AUD; the dollar sign comes from Grafana's USD unit.

panels.title: Unpaid
panels.description: Drinks taken and not paid for. The central question for an honour-system fridge (dashboard.md section 10).

panels.title: Average sale time

targets.queryText:
SELECT AVG(ts_end - ts_start) AS "Average"
FROM txn
WHERE outcome = 'paid' AND method = 'cash'
  AND ts_start IS NOT NULL AND ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT AVG(ts_end - ts_start) AS "Average"
FROM txn
WHERE outcome = 'paid' AND method = 'cash'
  AND ts_start IS NOT NULL AND ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}

panels.description: CASH ONLY, and that is a firmware limitation rather than a choice. A card sale's TXN_START is sent at the END of the transaction (dashboard.md section 6.2), so its start and end timestamps are the same instant and its duration would read as zero. Making notify_sale() fire on entering PaymentSelect would make this measurable for both.

ORDER BY ts_end

panels.title: Stock burn-down
panels.description: Counts fall as drinks are taken and jump straight back up on a restock. Nothing announces a restock - the next scan simply reports more drinks, which is why the camera is the source of truth (dashboard.md section 2).

targets.queryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds("ts", 300) AS ts,
       MAX(CASE WHEN drink = 'coke'   THEN count END) AS "Coke",
       MAX(CASE WHEN drink = 'fanta'  THEN count END) AS "Fanta",
       MAX(CASE WHEN drink = 'mtndew' THEN count END) AS "Mountain Dew",
       MAX(CASE WHEN drink = 'solo'   THEN count END) AS "Solo"
FROM stock_snapshot
WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds("ts", 300) AS ts,
       MAX(CASE WHEN drink = 'coke'   THEN count END) AS "Coke",
       MAX(CASE WHEN drink = 'fanta'  THEN count END) AS "Fanta",
       MAX(CASE WHEN drink = 'mtndew' THEN count END) AS "Mountain Dew",
       MAX(CASE WHEN drink = 'solo'   THEN count END) AS "Solo"

panels.title: Coin box drift
panels.description:
Measured mass on the load cell, minus the mass the logged coins should weigh, since the box was last emptied. Should be close to the unrecognised mass beside it: a washer that is not credited as a coin still weighs something.

EXACT agreement is not expected. The mass is sampled every 30 s while coins land instantly, so a coin arriving just after an emptying can sit outside the window - worth about one coin, hence the 15 g tolerance.

targets.queryText:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT ts, value, LAG(value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev
  FROM measurement WHERE metric = 'coinbox.mass_g'),
emptied AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ts), 0) AS t0 FROM m WHERE prev - value > 50),
measured AS (
  SELECT value AS g FROM measurement
  WHERE metric = 'coinbox.mass_g' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
logged AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mass_delta_g), 0) AS g FROM coin_event, emptied
  WHERE classified = 1 AND coin_event.ts > emptied.t0)
SELECT (SELECT g FROM measured) - (SELECT g FROM logged) AS "Drift"
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT ts, value, LAG(value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev
  FROM measurement WHERE metric = 'coinbox.mass_g'),
emptied AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ts), 0) AS t0 FROM m WHERE prev - value > 50),
measured AS (
  SELECT value AS g FROM measurement
  WHERE metric = 'coinbox.mass_g' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
logged AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mass_delta_g), 0) AS g FROM coin_event, emptied
  WHERE classified = 1 AND coin_event.ts > emptied.t0)
SELECT (SELECT g FROM measured) - (SELECT g FROM logged) AS "Drift"

panels.title: Unrecognised mass
panels.description: Mass that went into the box and was not a coin combination the classifier recognised - slugs, washers, or a knock on the box. CoinAcceptor already emits these (dashboard.md section 10); a rising total is either somebody trying it on or the classifier drifting.

panels.title: Stock reconciliation - camera vs ledger
panels.description:
Two independent accounts of the same shelf. The camera says what is there; the transaction ledger says what should be. Restocks are detected as upward jumps in the count and added in, so what is left is genuinely unexplained.

NEGATIVE means drinks left without a sale being recorded. Neither hardware nor message exists for this - it falls out of data already collected, which is the most novel part of the project (dashboard.md section 11).

targets.queryText:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT drink, ts, count,
         LAG(count) OVER (PARTITION BY drink ORDER BY ts) AS prev
  FROM stock_snapshot WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}),
base AS (
  SELECT drink, count FROM stock_snapshot
  WHERE ts = (SELECT MIN(ts) FROM stock_snapshot
              WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds})),
restock AS (
  SELECT drink, SUM(MAX(count - prev, 0)) AS r
  FROM s WHERE prev IS NOT NULL GROUP BY drink),
latest AS (
  SELECT drink, count FROM stock_snapshot
  WHERE ts = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM stock_snapshot
              WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds})),
sold AS (
  SELECT LOWER(i.drink) AS d, SUM(i.qty) AS q
  FROM txn_item i
  JOIN txn t ON t.boot_id = i.boot_id AND t.txn_id = i.txn_id
  WHERE t.outcome IN ('paid', 'stolen')
    AND t.ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT b.drink                                   AS "Drink",
       b.count                                   AS "At start",
       COALESCE(r.r, 0)                          AS "Restocked",
       COALESCE(so.q, 0)                         AS "Sold",
       l.count                                   AS "Now",
       l.count - (b.count + COALESCE(r.r, 0)
                  - COALESCE(so.q, 0))           AS "Unaccounted"
FROM base b
JOIN latest l ON l.drink = b.drink
LEFT JOIN restock r ON r.drink = b.drink
LEFT JOIN sold so ON so.d = b.drink
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT drink, ts, count,
         LAG(count) OVER (PARTITION BY drink ORDER BY ts) AS prev
  FROM stock_snapshot WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}),
base AS (
  SELECT drink, count FROM stock_snapshot
  WHERE ts = (SELECT MIN(ts) FROM stock_snapshot
              WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds})),
restock AS (
  SELECT drink, SUM(MAX(count - prev, 0)) AS r
  FROM s WHERE prev IS NOT NULL GROUP BY drink),
latest AS (
  SELECT drink, count FROM stock_snapshot
  WHERE ts = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM stock_snapshot
              WHERE ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds})),
sold AS (
  SELECT LOWER(i.drink) AS d, SUM(i.qty) AS q
  FROM txn_item i
  JOIN txn t ON t.boot_id = i.boot_id AND t.txn_id = i.txn_id
  WHERE t.outcome IN ('paid', 'stolen')
    AND t.ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT b.drink                                   AS "Drink",
       b.count                                   AS "At start",
       COALESCE(r.r, 0)                          AS "Restocked",
       COALESCE(so.q, 0)                         AS "Sold",
       l.count                                   AS "Now",
       l.count - (b.count + COALESCE(r.r, 0)
                  - COALESCE(so.q, 0))           AS "Unaccounted"
FROM base b
JOIN latest l ON l.drink = b.drink
LEFT JOIN restock r ON r.drink = b.drink
LEFT JOIN sold so ON so.d = b.drink
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Theft rate
panels.description: Share of completed transactions that ended unpaid, in six-hour buckets. The central question for an honour-system fridge (dashboard.md section 10) - a single number says little, the trend says whether it is getting worse.

targets.queryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds("ts_end", 21600) AS ts,
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'stolen' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / COUNT(*) AS "Theft rate"
FROM txn
WHERE outcome IS NOT NULL AND ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds("ts_end", 21600) AS ts,
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'stolen' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / COUNT(*) AS "Theft rate"
FROM txn
WHERE outcome IS NOT NULL AND ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Unpaid units per drink
panels.description:
Which drinks walk out without being paid for.

INCOMPLETE, and the reason is a firmware gap rather than a query: an abandoned CARD sale sends no TXN_START, so it arrives with no item list and cannot appear here (dashboard.md section 6.2). What is shown is real; the total is an undercount. Fixing notify_sale() to fire on entering PaymentSelect would close it.

targets.queryText:
SELECT i.drink AS "Drink", SUM(i.qty) AS "Unpaid units"
FROM txn_item i
JOIN txn t ON t.boot_id = i.boot_id AND t.txn_id = i.txn_id
WHERE t.outcome = 'stolen' AND t.ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT i.drink AS "Drink", SUM(i.qty) AS "Unpaid units"
FROM txn_item i
JOIN txn t ON t.boot_id = i.boot_id AND t.txn_id = i.txn_id
WHERE t.outcome = 'stolen' AND t.ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Board resets
panels.description: How many times the RP2040 restarted in this range. A cheap reliability metric: every reset is a transaction that may have been interrupted. Seeded history is excluded - it has one synthetic boot row that would otherwise read as a reset that never happened.

panels.title: Mean time between resets
panels.description: Blank until there have been at least two resets, which is correct rather than broken: one reset gives no interval to average.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1
            THEN (MAX(ts) - MIN(ts)) / (COUNT(*) - 1)
       END AS "Mean time between resets"
FROM boot
WHERE reason <> 'seed' AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1
            THEN (MAX(ts) - MIN(ts)) / (COUNT(*) - 1)
       END AS "Mean time between resets"
FROM boot
WHERE reason <> 'seed' AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}

panels.title: Temperature recovery - the ten longest door opens
panels.description:
What each long door open actually did to the top shelf: the average temperature in the five minutes before it, the peak reached during and shortly after, and the difference.

Costs no new hardware and no new message - it is a query over the door and temperature data already being collected, which is what makes it good report material (dashboard.md section 10). Top shelf because it sits behind the door and notices most; the freezer barely moves.

targets.queryText:
WITH longest AS (
  SELECT ts, duration_s FROM door_event
  WHERE state = 'open' AND duration_s IS NOT NULL
    AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
  ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT DATETIME(l.ts, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS "When",
       ROUND(l.duration_s)                        AS "Open (s)",
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(celsius) FROM temperature
              WHERE zone = 'fridge_top'
                AND ts BETWEEN l.ts - 300 AND l.ts), 2) AS "Before",
       ROUND((SELECT MAX(celsius) FROM temperature
              WHERE zone = 'fridge_top'
                AND ts BETWEEN l.ts
                            AND l.ts + l.duration_s + 300), 2) AS "Peak",
       ROUND((SELECT MAX(celsius) FROM temperature
              WHERE zone = 'fridge_top'
                AND ts BETWEEN l.ts AND l.ts + l.duration_s + 300)
             - (SELECT AVG(celsius) FROM temperature
                WHERE zone = 'fridge_top'
                  AND ts BETWEEN l.ts - 300 AND l.ts), 2) AS "Rise"
FROM longest l
ORDER BY l.duration_s DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH longest AS (
  SELECT ts, duration_s FROM door_event
  WHERE state = 'open' AND duration_s IS NOT NULL
    AND ts BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
  ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT DATETIME(l.ts, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS "When",
       ROUND(l.duration_s)                        AS "Open (s)",
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(celsius) FROM temperature
              WHERE zone = 'fridge_top'
                AND ts BETWEEN l.ts - 300 AND l.ts), 2) AS "Before",
       ROUND((SELECT MAX(celsius) FROM temperature
              WHERE zone = 'fridge_top'
                AND ts BETWEEN l.ts
                            AND l.ts + l.duration_s + 300), 2) AS "Peak",
       ROUND((SELECT MAX(celsius) FROM temperature
              WHERE zone = 'fridge_top'
                AND ts BETWEEN l.ts AND l.ts + l.duration_s + 300)
             - (SELECT AVG(celsius) FROM temperature
                WHERE zone = 'fridge_top'
                  AND ts BETWEEN l.ts - 300 AND l.ts), 2) AS "Rise"
FROM longest l
ORDER BY l.duration_s DESC

panels.title: Sensors — name a new one here

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(s.zone_label, '(not named yet)') AS "Zone",
       s.rom_code AS "ROM code",
       ROUND((SELECT value FROM measurement
              WHERE metric = 'temp.rom.' || s.rom_code
              ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), 2) AS "Latest C",
       DATETIME((SELECT MAX(ts) FROM measurement
                 WHERE metric = 'temp.rom.' || s.rom_code),
                'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS "Last reading"
FROM sensor s
ORDER BY (s.zone_label IS NULL) DESC, s.zone_label
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(s.zone_label, '(not named yet)') AS "Zone",
       s.rom_code AS "ROM code",
       ROUND((SELECT value FROM measurement
              WHERE metric = 'temp.rom.' || s.rom_code
              ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), 2) AS "Latest C",
       DATETIME((SELECT MAX(ts) FROM measurement
                 WHERE metric = 'temp.rom.' || s.rom_code),
                'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS "Last reading"
FROM sensor s
ORDER BY (s.zone_label IS NULL) DESC, s.zone_label

panels.title: Purchases by person
panels.description: Who is actually using the fridge. A sale nobody tapped a card for is counted as 'other' — the card is what identifies a purchase, and the fridge does not require one.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(m.label, 'other') AS "Person",
       COUNT(*)                   AS "Purchases"
FROM txn t
LEFT JOIN member m ON m.uid = t.member_uid
WHERE t.outcome = 'paid' AND t.ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(m.label, 'other') AS "Person",
       COUNT(*)                   AS "Purchases"
FROM txn t
LEFT JOIN member m ON m.uid = t.member_uid
WHERE t.outcome = 'paid' AND t.ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Spend by person
panels.description: The same split, in dollars rather than sales. Paid transactions only, so an abandoned basket does not appear as somebody's spending.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(m.label, 'other')   AS "Person",
       SUM(t.paid_cents) / 100.0 AS "Spent"
FROM txn t
LEFT JOIN member m ON m.uid = t.member_uid
WHERE t.outcome = 'paid' AND t.ts_end BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Members — name a new one here
panels.description:
Every card the reader has ever seen. A card appears here automatically the first time it is tapped, with no name, and its taps and purchases are counted straight away. Give it a name with

  UPDATE member SET label='Damien Turner' WHERE uid='04404C22C06780';

Naming a card names its ENTIRE history, not just purchases from that moment on, because the name is joined on at read time. The name lives here rather than in the firmware's approved list so that adding one is a row, not a rebuild and a reflash.

Deliberately not filtered by the dashboard's time range: a card you are trying to name is usually one whose only tap was outside it.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(m.label, '(not named yet)') AS "Name",
       m.uid                                    AS "Card UID",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rfid_event r
         WHERE r.uid = m.uid AND r.granted = 1)  AS "Taps",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn t
         WHERE t.member_uid = m.uid AND t.outcome = 'paid') AS "Purchases",
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.paid_cents), 0) / 100.0 FROM txn t
         WHERE t.member_uid = m.uid AND t.outcome = 'paid') AS "Spent",
       DATETIME((SELECT MAX(r.ts) FROM rfid_event r WHERE r.uid = m.uid),
                'unixepoch', 'localtime')       AS "Last tap"
FROM member m
ORDER BY (m.label IS NULL) DESC, m.label
